ios.desc: Ever struggle to remember what companies you have applied with, what stage your at with a company, or if you have applied and been rejected, this is a simple app to solve that issue

android.desc: Have you ever wanted to know how many jobs you had applied for, what company, have you heard back from them, or what stage your at, this makes it easier

quotes.text:
Location: Darlington, UK

Remote: Preferred

Willing to relcocate: No

Technologies: Go, Rust, Typescript, Swift

I am a software engineer with 25+ years experience,

recently I have been keeping myself relativly sane by building https://interviews.tools an interview planning site and its companion apps for iOS (native swift) https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/interviews-tool/id6756259187
Interviews.tool and Android (native kotlin) https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=tools.interviews.android

source of all of those is available on github https://github.com/keloran

I have also built various tools over time for example https://flags.gg which is a feature flag system with a ton of native sdks, https://github.com/flags-gg

--

I don't mind doing technical tests but I hate technical interviews (where people have to watch me type) really if you want to know what kind of code I can produce look at my github repos, there is easily 100-200k lines of code
